title: The Ultimate 15-Phase Roadmap for Becoming a Production-Ready AI Engineer
description: While Data Scientists focus on statistical analysis and model building, AI Engineers bridge the gap between prototypes and high-performance production software.

phases.title: Applied Math & Python Foundations
phases.description: Core programming primitives, async IO, vector math, and data processing.

topics.name: Python for AI & Async Programming
topics.description: Mastering generators, decorators, type hints, asyncio, and concurrent execution for LLM streaming pipelines.

topics.name: Linear Algebra & Vector Operations
topics.description: Dot products, cosine similarity, matrix multiplications, and tensor operations using NumPy and PyTorch.

topics.name: Probability, Statistics & Information Theory
topics.description: Bayesian inference, Cross-Entropy loss, KL Divergence, and perplexity metrics used in language modeling.

phases.title: Neural Networks & Deep Learning Essentials
phases.description: Architectural principles behind modern deep learning models.

topics.name: Perceptrons & Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs)
topics.description: Building neural nets from scratch, forward propagation, activation functions (ReLU, GELU, SwiGLU).

topics.name: Backpropagation & Autograd Engines
topics.description: Understanding gradient descent, automatic differentiation algorithms, and PyTorch autograd computations.

topics.name: Optimization Algorithms (AdamW, Lion, Cosine Annealing)
topics.description: Learning rates, weight decay, gradient clipping, and scheduler strategies for stable model training.

phases.title: Transformer Architecture Deep Dive
phases.description: The foundation of all modern Large Language Models.

topics.name: Scaled Dot-Product & Multi-Head Self-Attention
topics.description: Implementing Q, K, V projections, soft-max scaling, and causal masking mechanisms.

topics.name: Positional Embeddings (RoPE & ALiBi)
topics.description: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), relative vs absolute embeddings, and context window scaling.

topics.name: Encoder-Decoder vs Decoder-Only Models
topics.description: Comparing BERT, T5, GPT-4, and Llama architectural trade-offs.

phases.title: Tokenization & LLM Data Engineering
phases.description: Preparing and tokenizing unstructured text at scale.

topics.name: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) & SentencePiece
topics.description: How tokenizers tokenize text, vocabulary generation, handling out-of-vocabularies, and tiktoken usage.

topics.name: Data Cleaning & Deduplication at Scale
topics.description: MinHash LSH, perplexity filtering, data quality scoring pipelines for pretraining data.

phases.title: Prompt Engineering & In-Context Learning
phases.description: Extracting maximum reasoning capabilities from LLMs without updating weights.

topics.name: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) & Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT)
topics.description: Systematic prompting techniques, few-shot examples, and self-consistency sampling.

topics.name: Structured Output Generation (JSON/Pydantic)
topics.description: Enforcing schema constraints using Instructor, Outlines, and grammar-guided decoding.

phases.title: Embeddings & Vector Databases
phases.description: Semantic search, indexing, and high-dimensional space querying.

topics.name: Vector Embeddings & Distance Metrics
topics.description: Dense vs sparse vectors, Cosine, Euclidean, and Dot Product metrics comparison.

topics.name: Vector Indexing Algorithms (HNSW, IVF-PQ)
topics.description: Approximate Nearest Neighbors (ANN), HNSW graph construction, and quantization trade-offs.

topics.name: Vector DB Production Setup (Qdrant / Pinecone / pgvector)
topics.description: Indexing strategies, metadata filtering, payload management, and hybrid keyword search.

phases.title: Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
phases.description: Building enterprise knowledge engines with LLMs.

topics.name: Chunking & Parsing Strategies
topics.description: Recursive character chunking, semantic chunking, layout-aware PDF parsing (Unstructured / LlamaParse).

topics.name: Query Rewriting & HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings)
topics.description: Expanding user queries, multi-query generation, and sub-question breakdown.

topics.name: Reranking Models (Cohere Rerank / Cross-Encoders)
topics.description: Two-stage retrieval architectures, scoring candidate documents for precision.

phases.title: Autonomous AI Agents & Multi-Agent Frameworks
phases.description: Goal-oriented agents equipped with tools, memory, and planning.

topics.name: ReAct Pattern (Reasoning + Acting)
topics.description: Designing loop controllers that execute tool calls and interpret observations.

topics.name: Agent Memory Architecture (Short-term, Long-term, Episodic)
topics.description: Buffer memory, summary memory, and vector-persisted memory banks.

topics.name: Multi-Agent Systems (LangGraph / CrewAI / AutoGen)
topics.description: Graph-based state machines, agent collaboration, human-in-the-loop validation.

phases.title: Function Calling & Tool Integration
phases.description: Connecting LLMs to APIs, SQL databases, and web browsers.

topics.name: OpenAI Function Calling & Tool Specs
topics.description: Writing JSON Schema definitions for function parameter validation.

topics.name: Text-to-SQL & Database Querying Agents
topics.description: Dynamic schema extraction, SQL query generation, dry-run evaluation, and execution.

phases.title: Model Fine-Tuning & Parameter-Efficient Tuning (PEFT)
phases.description: Adapting open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Qwen) to specific domains.

topics.name: LoRA & QLoRA Deep Dive
topics.description: Low-Rank Adaptation matrices, 4-bit NF4 quantization, and gradient checkpointing.

topics.name: SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) Data Formatting
topics.description: Preparing ShareGPT / ChatML prompt-response datasets for fine-tuning.

topics.name: Alignment with DPO & PPO (Direct Preference Optimization)
topics.description: RLHF concepts, preference pair training, and DPO loss functions.

phases.title: High-Performance LLM Serving & Inference
phases.description: Optimizing latency, throughput, and GPU memory usage.

topics.name: PagedAttention & vLLM Architecture
topics.description: KV cache memory fragmentation, continuous batching, and throughput benchmarks.

topics.name: Model Quantization Techniques (AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF)
topics.description: Int8/Int4 quantization, CPU inference with llama.cpp, and memory footprints.

topics.name: Speculative Decoding & Tensor Parallelism
topics.description: Draft models, multi-GPU model splitting, and pipeline parallelism.

phases.title: Multimodal AI (Vision, Audio & Speech)
phases.description: Processing images, audio, and video alongside text.

topics.name: Vision-Language Models (VLM) Architecture
topics.description: CLIP embeddings, LLaVA projection layers, and image patch tokenization.

topics.name: Speech Recognition & Synthesis (Whisper & ElevenLabs)
topics.description: Streaming audio transcribing, voice cloning, and real-time audio channels.

phases.title: LLM Evaluation & Benchmarking (LLMops)
phases.description: Measuring RAG accuracy, hallucination rates, and model quality.

topics.name: Ragas & TruLens Evaluation Metrics
topics.description: Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Recall, and Context Precision metrics.

topics.name: LLM-as-a-Judge & Automated Red-Teaming
topics.description: Building judge prompts, pairwise comparisons, and automated dataset test suites.

phases.title: Security, Alignment & Guardrails
phases.description: Protecting production LLM systems against malicious input.

topics.name: Prompt Injection & Jailbreak Defense
topics.description: Indirect prompt injection attacks, input sanitization, NeMo Guardrails setup.

topics.name: Pll Redaction & Output Safety Filters
topics.description: Detecting sensitive customer data, PII filtering, and content policy enforcement.

phases.title: Production Deployment & Monitoring Infrastructure
phases.description: End-to-end production AI infrastructure, tracing, and cost optimization.

topics.name: LLM Tracing & Observability (LangSmith / Phoenix / Arize)
topics.description: Tracing chain calls, latency breakdowns, token consumption tracking, and session debugging.

topics.name: Semantic Caching (GPTCache / Redis Vector)
topics.description: Caching similar prompt responses to decrease cost and latency by 90%.

topics.name: Production Architecture & Cost Management
topics.description: Designing fallback routing, rate limiting, fallback models, and serverless GPU scaling.
